symptoms.symptom: The oven door feels hotter than before, after the oven door glass has been removed for cleaning.

causes.label: The oven door glass is not inserted the right way round.
remedies: Check if the oven door glass is inserted the right way round (low-E symbol can be read).
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "The oven door glass is not inserted the right way round."

symptoms.symptom: The oven door is not balanced.

causes.label: The inner door glass is missing or has not been inserted during reassembly.
remedies: Check if the inner door glass is present or has been inserted during reassembly.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "The inner door glass is missing or has not been inserted during reassembly."

symptoms.symptom: The cookware produces a crackling noise.

causes.label: The cookware is made from different multilayered materials
remedies: Refer to the section on Cooking with Induction to learn more about suitable cookware. → Page 19
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "The cookware is made from different multilayered materials"

causes.label: You are using cookware of different sizes and different materials.
remedies: Refer to the section on Cooking with Induction to learn more about suitable cookware. → Page 19
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "You are using cookware of different sizes and different materials."

symptoms.symptom: The cooktop SpeedBoost® function cannot be activated or turns off before 10 minutes have elapsed.

causes.label: The cooking zone is too hot.
remedies: Let the cooking zone cool down.
Set the SpeedBoost® function again.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "The cooking zone is too hot."

symptoms.symptom: The display is frozen or does not respond.

causes.label: Various causes are possible.
remedies: Check if the panel lock function is active.
‒ Deactivate the panel lock.
→ "Deactivating the panel lock", Page 22 If the panel lock function is not active:
‒ Disconnect the appliance from the power supply, using the corresponding switch on the domestic switch board.
‒ Wait a couple of seconds and reconnect the appliance to the power supply.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "Various causes are possible."

causes.label: The power supply has been disconnected.
remedies: Check whether the lighting in your kitchen or other appliances in the room are working.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "The power supply has been disconnected."

causes.label: The appliance has not been connected as shown in the circuit diagram.
remedies: Disconnect the appliance from the power supply.
Make sure the appliance has been connected as shown in the circuit diagram. There is an electronics fault ▶ If the fault cannot be eliminated, call Customer Service.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "The appliance has not been connected as shown in the circuit diagram."

symptoms.symptom: The power level in one of the cooking zones is blinking.

causes.label: The maximum available power of the cooktop has been exceeded.
remedies: Turn the control knob to a lower power level within 3 seconds.
If you do not set a different power level, the power level of the affected cooking
zone will be reduced automatically.
→ "Power management", Page 19
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 38: "The maximum available power of the cooktop has been exceeded."

causes.label: The cooking zone has been operating continuously for an extended period of time without interaction. The automatic time limitation has been triggered.
remedies: Touch any control element.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 39: "The cooking zone has been operating continuously for an extended period of time without interaction. The automatic time limitation has been triggered."

causes.label: a You can set the cooking zone and continue to cook. The supply voltage is incorrect. It is outside the normal operating range.
remedies: Contact your electrical utility provider.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 39: "a You can set the cooking zone and continue to cook. The supply voltage is incorrect. It is outside the normal operating range."

causes.label: The cooking zone is unable to detect cookware.
remedies: Place cookware on the cooking zone within 30 seconds after setting a power
level.
If cookware is present on the cooking zone, check if the cookware is suitable for
induction cooking.
→ "Induction cooking", Page 19
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 39: "The cooking zone is unable to detect cookware."

causes.label: The set power level can not be executed.
remedies: Turn the control knob to 0 and then set a power level again.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 39: "The set power level can not be executed."

causes.label: The control knob has been pushed in for more than 30 seconds.
remedies: Make sure the control knob is released after setting the power level.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 39: "The control knob has been pushed in for more than 30 seconds."
